'''Insectomorphs''' were [[Insect/Legends|insectoid]] creatures used as riding mounts by [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Dug cavalier/Legends|cavaliers]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Insectomorph.png|thumb|left|180px|A mounted insectomorph]]
Insectomorphs had a gray hide marked with greenish-yellow stripes. They moved on four [[Limb/Legends|legs]] that ended in two long toe-like pads. Their hind legs were roughly twice the length of their front legs and considerably more muscular. Their short, blunt heads protruded just between the shoulder joints of the shorter front legs and had a wide sharp-[[Tooth/Legends|toothed]] mouth and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].

==History==
Insectomorphs were ridden as cavalry mounts by [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Dug cavalier/Legends|cavaliers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Several were killed by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] as their riders charged against the overwhelming enemy forces armed only with [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]].
